study_identification_part.si_4_title: Cell type-specific manifestations of cortical thickness heterogeneity in schizophrenia

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Quantile regression used to derive normative ranges (percentiles) of regional cortical thickness as a function of age and sex.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Quantile regression [18] was used to obtain a normative range of regional CTh variation as a function of age and sex [3]

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional cortical thickness (CTh) for 34 cortical regions.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: To characterize CTh heterogeneity, normative ranges were established for 34 cortical regions and the extent of deviation from these ranges was measured for each individual with schizophrenia.
